title: SIEM: collection, normalisation, correlation and rules

videos.script: Three lessons gave you sources, and a copy of each in one place. Now somebody has to read them. {{read}} Nobody reads three hundred lines a day by hand, let alone three million. A SIEM is the machine that reads them first. {{siem}} It collects every source, turns each line into the same named fields, keeps them, and runs rules over them. In this lesson you build a small one. {{build}} A week of logs from the lab's company, a table in SQLite, and rules written in Sigma, an open format that converts into the query language of whatever SIEM you have. Your first rule will be wrong. It will flag three people who mistyped a password. {{wrong}} Making it right is the real subject of the lesson.
